context: M14 o6. Kafeneio Kastoria, W 29th & 8th. Backgammon clacks. Mayhew sweats over Greek coffee.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: Furs paid? Good. Kallis is a gentleman. Varelas is a gentleman with a bank problem.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: Where'd you— He's a lawyer. Everybody's got a lawyer.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: You showed me his picture once already, kid. Don't make it a habit.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: He dropped his toothpick. Carl hasn't dropped a toothpick since nineteen sixty-four.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: Drink your coffee. Greeks make it like mud. Good mud.
